text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Summer camp is over, along with all our scheduled plans.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much, Trainer. My body feels a little better now…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thanks to the special care Manhattan Cafe received over the summer, her symptoms are looking a little better.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Hello there. Make any progress with Cafe this summer?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her what I learned about Manhattan Cafe's friend.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Interesting. So she can often be helpful, but sometimes exhibit bizarre behavior.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Meaning… No, wait. If we think in terms of external pressure, or perhaps an impulse for self-harm, then…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon gets lost in a sea of thought.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Come what may, fall awaits. We endured through the spring, knowing we had fall to work toward.
